scenarios.name: b16_dynamic_tail_budget
scenarios.what: b16 defaults; P=21, so the 5-token tail (holding a stop id) rides in the first decode block; runs to max_new_tokens 40 and returns 43 (block end)
scenarios.ref_sampler: huggingface_bd3.py sampler at T=1, top_k=1 (confidence before the filter)

scenarios.name: b16_dynamic_aligned_stop
scenarios.what: b16 defaults; P=32 (two prefill passes); a stop id lands mid-block in the second decode block, the rest of that block is still decoded and committed
scenarios.ref_sampler: huggingface_bd3.py sampler at T=1, top_k=1 (confidence before the filter)

scenarios.name: b16_static_short_prompt_stop
scenarios.what: static, one token per step; P=9 < block, so no prefill pass; stop in the first block
scenarios.ref_sampler: huggingface_bd3.py sampler at T=1, top_k=1 (confidence before the filter)
